caption_search_cues.caption_excerpt: Fig. 1: Overview of RoboLab. RoboLab addresses large-scale evaluation of real-world policies via a novel evaluation framework. By introducing a streamlined pipeline for generating new scenes and tasks (top row), RoboLab enables rapid extensibility for testing generalization capabilities. Fig. 2: Three approaches for robotic benchmarks. LEFT: To date, pure simulation based benchmarks have exhibited low visual quality, creating a large sim2real transfer gap. MIDDLE: Real2sim benchmarks address this issue by using techniques to bring real-world visual texture into simulation.
